title: Patient Safety in German Radiation Oncology (PaSaGeRO) - Development of an assessment instrument for patient safety
summary:
Contrary to its high relevance, there is currently no instrument for the structured assessment of PS in a radiotherapy facility. In contrast to the quality indicators frequently implemented in oncology, subject-specific patient safety indicators (PSIs) have not yet been defined in Germany. For various reasons, the current safety indicators are not suitable for evaluating radiotherapy procedures; for example, there is no dedicated recording of outpatient care, although around 80% of radiotherapy patients are treated on an outpatient basis. The selection of safety-relevant measures and processes and their evaluation is the responsibility of the respective facility. Due to the lack of central standards, each facility must devote considerable resources to establishing individual solutions. Furthermore, a non-standardized approach entails the risk that essential core points for maintaining patient safety remain underrepresented in the established processes. 

The aim of this mixed methods study is to develop a questionnaire to assess PS specifically in the field of radiotherapy. The focus will be on the evaluation of processes and structures in the facilities. The final questionnaire will be available digitally and, as a self-assessment tool, will show users weak points and potential for improvement in their facility.
conditions: The study is open for patient representers and patients with all tumors.

interventions.name: Patients and staff involved in radiation oncology in Germany

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patient or employee in radiotherapy in Germany or patient representative
Exclusion criteria:
Language impairment/insufficient knowledge of German
